name: Boom Chaka Laka | 1.3g Live Resin Tarantula | Maui Wowie
description: Bright, tropical, and full of energy — Maui Wowi delivers sunny flavor with an uplifting, heady high that keeps the vibe light and lively. This sativa is perfect for daytime sessions, creative moments, or anytime you want to stay energized and in a good mood. Think island fruit and beach-day bliss in every hit.
